/-- `exitFrame_releases_all` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; §10): after the exit, every active authority has
a live holder; none is held by the exited frame. -/
theorem exitFrame_releases_all {s s' : S3} {f : Nat} {F₀ : Frames} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3 s)
    (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (h : ExitStep s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
      HolderLive s' y.holder ∧ y.holder ≠ .frame f := by
  have hp := exit_preserves hwf hinv h
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro j y hy ya
  have hl := hp.1.poss j y hy ya
  refine ⟨hl, fun he => ?_⟩
  rw [he] at hl
  have hnd := List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hwf.nodup)
  have : (exitEff s).F = F₀ := by rw [exitEff_eq hF]
  exact hnd.1 (this ▸ hl)

/-- `exitFrame_kills_locals` (MM-03.3.1; MM-03.3 §4, O7; A5): after the exit, every usable place
was usable before; a place owned by the exited frame is no longer usable, nor is any place whose
owner chain passed through such a place; and no active authority is held by a holder that is no
longer live. -/
theorem exitFrame_kills_locals {s s' : S3} {f : Nat} {F₀ : Frames} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3 s)
    (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (h : ExitStep s (.ok s')) :
    (∀ q, s'.Usable q → s.Usable q) ∧
    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f → ¬ s'.Usable q) ∧
    (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true → HolderLive s' y.holder) := by
  have hp := exit_preserves hwf hinv h
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have e := exitEff_eq hF
  have hnd := List.nodup_cons.1 (hF ▸ hwf.nodup)
  refine ⟨fun q hq => ?_, fun q pl hq ho hu => ?_, hp.1.poss⟩
  · exact S3.Usable.mono (by rw [e]) (fun g hg => by rw [e] at hg; exact hF ▸ List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hg)
      (fun _ h => by rw [e] at h; exact h) hq
  · cases hu with
    | frame hpl _ ho' hf =>
      have : (exitEff s).P = s.P := by rw [e]
      rw [this, hq] at hpl; cases hpl; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'
      rw [e] at hf; exact hnd.1 hf
    | place hpl _ ho' _ =>
      have : (exitEff s).P = s.P := by rw [e]
      rw [this, hq] at hpl; cases hpl; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'

    (hinv : Inv3 s) (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (h : ExitStep s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ q, s'.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, ∃ z, (z = x ∨ z ∈ s.ancs x) ∧ z ∈ s'.D q ∧ s'.Active z := by

verdicts.title: issue on a full arena whose blocks are still live returns reject, not fail (A10); the 'full arena -> fail' test only passes because it was built artificially
verdicts.reason: I re-ran cx.lean with `lake build` up to date and got no errors. A control file with false examples does error. CX1 holds: arena a2.2 is full with both blocks live, every IssuePre clause except the region clause decides true, `effective a2.1 1 2 = none`, and the IssueStep result is `.reject`; `.fail` is refuted. IssueStep (l.3132-3139) gives fail only under IssuePre ∧ ¬Avail. IssuePre (l.3101) requires `effective s ar.internal l = some .modify`, and a live block derived from internal removes that right. So any region that is unavailable because a live block holds it is rejected. With live blocks, no region gives fail. A10 says "fail (état inchangé) si la région est indisponible". The module settles the overlap between §6 "dispose de l'autorité nécessaire" (reject) and A10 (fail) as reject first. No docstring flags this; a grep for fail/interpret/ambig finds nothing. Test n10a reaches fail only after ending both blocks, so the plain full arena (blocks in use) gives the opposite verdict. The test at l.3579 shows the same reject.

verdicts.title: A2 '≥' read as '≥ the mode of the held authority': one Observe sharing of a value makes its owned storage unreachable, even for reads by the owning frame
verdicts.reason: A2's text "une autorité exerçable de mode effectif ≥ sur toute l'empreinte de p" gives no comparand for ≥. Elsewhere it ties exercise to a mode ("transfer (Modify sur source et destination)"; A6 "Modify exerçable"). S3.Exercisable.held (l.607) picks `Allows (effective s b l) y.mode`, the held authority's mode, and no docstring flags that choice. CX2 re-checked by decide: after one Observe derivation on value 0, `Read3Step 1 [1] b1 .reject`, `DeriveStep 1 1 .observe b1 .reject`, `¬ b1.Exercisable 1`. A callee given only an Observe on the value cannot read the value's owned storage. Under the other reading (≥ the requested mode), auth 0 still has effective Observe on [0], so the read would be accepted. The two readings therefore change which programs are accepted. AGENTS treats that as a semantic question to report, not one to settle silently.

verdicts.title: Owned places of the ended or freed value: endUse blocks accesses to them, free does not; after free, a logically dead owned place is still readable and its root is released while a descendant is active
verdicts.reason: A6 uses the same phrase for both operations: "aucune autorité active dérivée sur l'empreinte de p détenue ailleurs". EndUseAccessOK widens it to EndingLeaf, which adds the leaves of places that stop being usable. FreeAccessOK (l.2804) keeps `footprint s.P p` only. CX3a decides `EndUseStep K0 0 e1 .reject`, caused only by an Observe on owned leaf 1, which is outside `footprint e1.P 0 = [0]`. That is stricter than A6's literal text. CX3b decides `FreeStep KF1 1 7 f2 (.ok _)`. Afterwards place 2 is not usable but not freed, auth 2 (the root of place 2, held by freed place 1) is inactive, and its descendant auth 3 is still active. `Read3Step 3 [2]` on a dead place is ok. In f2, ReleaseStep 2 is rejected (O3.2) and EndUse of the box is rejected. So the module reads one A6 phrase in two ways and leaves an orphan active access on a logically dead place. No docstring reports the gap.

verdicts.title: ArenaInv does not make `internal` the root of the storage: issued regions may lie outside the administered storage (weaker than A10, §6 and pass 1)
verdicts.reason: ArenaInv (l.3072-3081) bounds regions by `s.afp ar.internal`. It requires only that internal be a Modify root held by the storage's owner. Nothing ties `afp internal` to `footprint s.P ar.storage`, although A10 says "internal = sa racine" (of the storage). Pass 1 (f39ab7a l.2094) had issued ⊆ storage and `∀ l ∈ ar.storage, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal`. No arena-creation step exists, so ArenaInv is the only constraint on arenas. CX5 checks: ArenaInv holds for internal = the root of place 2, which is not the storage place 1. Issue [2] is ok, and `footprint h1.1.P 1 = [1]` while issued = [([2],4)]. The conclusion of arena_issue_preserves_disjointness is therefore weaker than §6 "Les régions émises sont incluses dans le stockage administré". This weakens a pass-1 statement, which the brief forbids.

verdicts.title: §10 theorem release_restores_authority (and pass-1 split_unsound_without_DD) removed in pass 2 and never rebuilt
verdicts.reason: Spec §10 lists `release_restores_authority` among the milestone-1 theorems. It existed in pass 1 (f39ab7a l.1514-1517). `comm -23` of the pass-1 and pass-2 theorem names lists both release_restores_authority and split_unsound_without_DD. `grep -n restor` on the current module finds nothing. The pass-2 release theorems (releaseEff_eq, release_org, release_ancs, release_preserves) never state that the ancestor's effective mode is restored. Commit 2a56a2a says the pass-1 proofs are "rebuilt in later steps", but no later commit restores them. The report (formal/reports/MM03_v0.1_p2.md) does not exist yet, so no justification is given either. KT now makes DDSound trivial (l.3519), and nothing shows the DDSound hypothesis is needed.

verdicts.title: free requires `OwnedRoot` (no parent), a condition A6 does not state, added to make WF3 preservation go through
verdicts.reason: A6 asks for "un emplacement possédé" and leaves freeability to "K.Deallocable p (unité libérable selon le contrat de l'allocateur)". WF3 (l.1161-1162) makes a part share its parent's owner and dead flag, so a part of an owned place is itself owned. CX4 decides `FreeStep KG 2 7 g0 .reject` and `¬ OwnedRoot g0 2`. It also decides every other FreePre conjunct, and `owner = .place 0`. The rejection therefore comes only from parent = none. free_preserves (l.2879-2888) destructs hroot to get `parentOf s.P p = none` for partOf_parent, so the restriction is the proof's need. A6 does not justify it, and the module does not flag it.

verdicts.title: A7 re-anchoring stops at authorities held by places, while A7 says 'held by a surviving frame'; the interpretation is not flagged
verdicts.reason: A7 reads "jusqu'à la première autorité active détenue par un cadre survivant ; reject si la chaîne atteint la racine d'un emplacement du cadre sortant". Survives/firstSurv (l.952-970) count any holder live after the pop, including places, and the docstring cites only A4/A5. CX6 decides that c16d's returned block has origin 1 (internal), held by `.place 0`. Under the literal A7 the chain from the block reaches internal (place-held, not a frame) and then a root that belongs to the caller, not to the exiting frame. Neither the stop condition nor the reject condition applies, so the literal text gives no outcome. The module fills the gap with the transitive reading without stating it as an interpretation of A7.

verdicts.reason: The exitFrame_kills_locals docstring (l.2433-2436) says "nor is any place whose owner chain passed through such a place". It existed in pass 1 (f39ab7a l.1514-1517). `comm -23` of the pass-1 and pass-2 theorem names lists both release_restores_authority and split_unsound_without_DD. `grep -n restor` on the current module finds nothing. The pass-2 release theorems (releaseEff_eq, release_org, release_ancs, release_preserves) never state that the ancestor's effective mode is restored. Commit 2a56a2a says the pass-1 proofs are "rebuilt in later steps", but no later commit restores them. The report (formal/reports/MM03_v0.1_p2.md) does not exist yet, so no justification is given either. KT now makes DDSound trivial (l.3519), and nothing shows the DDSound hypothesis is needed.

verdicts.title: free requires `OwnedRoot` (no parent), a condition A6 does not state, added to make WF3 preservation go through
verdicts.reason: A6 asks for "un emplacement possédé" and leaves freeability to "K.Deallocable p (unité libérable selon le contrat de l'allocateur)". WF3 (l.1161-1162) makes a part share its parent's owner and dead flag, so a part of an owned place is itself owned. CX4 decides `FreeStep KG 2 7 g0 .reject` and `¬ OwnedRoot g0 2`. It also decides every other FreePre conjunct, and `owner = .place 0`. The rejection therefore comes only from parent = none. free_preserves (l.2879-2888) destructs hroot to get `parentOf s.P p = none` for partOf_parent, so the restriction is the proof's need. A6 does not justify it, and the module does not flag it.

verdicts.title: A7 re-anchoring stops at authorities held by places, while A7 says 'held by a surviving frame'; the interpretation is not flagged
verdicts.reason: A7 reads "jusqu'à la première autorité active détenue par un cadre survivant ; reject si la chaîne atteint la racine d'un emplacement du cadre sortant". Survives/firstSurv (l.952-970) count any holder live after the pop, including places, and the docstring cites only A4/A5. CX6 decides that c16d's returned block has origin 1 (internal), held by `.place 0`. Under the literal A7 the chain from the block reaches internal (place-held, not a frame) and then a root that belongs to the caller, not to the exiting frame. Neither the stop condition nor the reject condition applies, so the literal text gives no outcome. The module fills the gap with the transitive reading without stating it as an interpretation of A7.

verdicts.title: Docstrings claim more than the statements prove (exitFrame_kills_locals, free_marks_freed)
verdicts.reason: The exitFrame_kills_locals docstring (l.2433-2436) says "nor is any place whose owner chain passed through such a place". The statement (l.2440) covers only `pl.owner = .frame f`, so the transitive case required by the task (A5, step 1) is not stated. The free_marks_freed docstring (l.2929) says "`free` is the only operation that releases storage". The statement (l.2931-2932) only describes `freed` after a FreeStep. Apart from endUse_no_dealloc_event, no theorem says other steps leave `freed` unchanged; enterEff even rewrites `freed` (l.923). Both docstrings claim more than is proved.
